title: Retrain and champion/challenger, and lessons from use: a challenger replaces the model in use only when better on rows neither saw (34.11, 34.12)
request: The owner asked to finish Phase 10 without stopping. The plan (docs/guides/PHASE10_ABILITIES_PLAN.md, 34.11 and 34.12) asks for a retrain policy, a challenger trained on newer labelled rows through the same engine, compared with the champion on the latest window neither trained on, promoted only beyond its interval, every comparison recorded, and lessons proposed from drift, promotions and refusals.
spec: dclab_core/retrain.py (RetrainPolicy v1, should_retrain, ChallengerRecord v1, compare); dclab_rnd/studio/retrain.py (newer rows kept beside the project, the comparison as a job, the ledger point model.promote); dclab_rnd/studio/lessons_from_use.py.
plan: the core: a policy, a paired comparison on a window, a record
simulate a changing and an unchanging world over twenty seeds
the studio: newer rows read as the engine reads training rows, the champion refitted as the export does, the challenger the same with newer rows
routes, a job, an event, the ledger, lessons

decisions.decision: Keep newer rows beside the project, never as one of its tables
decisions.why: attaching a table clears every stage, so the final stage would read the holdout again just to compare

decisions.decision: Drop newer rows that repeat a row of the project's own table
decisions.why: a re-export of the project's holdout would otherwise decide a promotion while the holdout count stays unchanged

decisions.decision: The champion is the fit last promoted, else the approved model
decisions.why: a challenger must beat the model in use, not an older one

decisions.decision: Never promote on fewer than thirty window rows or five of a class
decisions.why: a zero-width interval on a handful of rows promoted

change: dclab_core/retrain.py (new); dclab_rnd/studio/retrain.py and lessons_from_use.py (new); jobs/handlers.py, agentic/services.py, routers/projects.py (two routes and an upload), experience/hooks.py, ledger/__init__.py (model.promote captured), lessons.py (a from-use lesson's evidence text); contracts and schemas; tests.

findings.defect: an equally good challenger is promoted about one time in twenty
findings.scenario: twenty seeds without a change: one promoted
findings.fix: said in the module and the integration guide; a margin above zero makes it rarer
findings.impact: a needless redeploy, never a worse model

findings.defect: attaching newer rows as a table forced a second holdout read
findings.scenario: the studio test could not rerun the final stage without a written reason
findings.cause: attaching a table clears the stages
findings.fix: newer rows kept beside the project, never read by the engine, no stage cleared

findings.defect: two comparisons in one second shared a lesson key
findings.scenario: the second comparison's lesson was never proposed
findings.cause: the key was the comparison's time to the second
findings.fix: each comparison has its own id

findings.defect: the promotion never reached the ledger
findings.scenario: the ledger refused it twice: unknown state fields and a yes or no point given words
findings.cause: the record did not follow the point's shape
findings.fix: a yes or no with the measure and the window's size
findings.impact: every comparison said to be captured, none was

findings.defect: labels from unconfirmed sources were trained and judged on
findings.scenario: a fraud project with rule-labelled newer rows
findings.cause: the newer rows skipped the step that sets those labels aside
findings.fix: the same step as the training rows

findings.defect: one entity could sit in the challenger's training rows and the window
findings.scenario: monthly snapshots of the same customers
findings.cause: the window was cut by rows
findings.fix: an entity in the window has none of its rows among the challenger's; the interval over whole entities

findings.defect: one bad time stamp made every time missing
findings.scenario: a single unreadable date in the newer rows
findings.cause: the column fell back to numbers when any stamp failed
findings.fix: the time read as the project reads it; a row without one is left out

findings.defect: a code read as 1.0 was a new category to the champion
findings.scenario: a CSV with one blank cell turned a count column to decimals
findings.cause: the newer rows kept their own types

findings.defect: a re-export of the project's rows decided a promotion
findings.scenario: the project's table again with a few new rows
findings.cause: nothing compared the newer rows with the project's
findings.fix: repeat rows dropped and counted; the window only after the project's latest time
findings.impact: the holdout's labels used to promote without counting a read

findings.scenario: one to four rows promoted on a zero-width interval
findings.fix: thirty rows and five of a class at least

findings.defect: the comparison used another measure than the project's
findings.scenario: a multiclass project judged by accuracy instead of its own measure
findings.fix: the project's own measure and direction

findings.defect: later comparisons were against the approved model after a promotion
findings.scenario: a second challenger beat an older model, not the one in use
findings.cause: the champion was always the final stage's fit
findings.fix: the champion is the last promoted fit and its rows

findings.defect: storage, audit, live reports and Stop were loose
findings.scenario: files outside the storage, no audit entry, a malformed live report failing after saving, Stop ignored mid-fit
findings.cause: a first version written beside the conventions
findings.fix: the project's file storage, a data-import audit entry, the report validated first, a check between the fits

measurements.name: promotion over twenty seeds
measurements.gate: promoted after a change in at least 19 of 20 and without it in at most 1 of 20
measurements.result: promoted after the change in 20 of 20, better by about 0.19 ROC AUC; promoted without it in 1 of 20
measurements.next: the main product's model registry wires it
limits: simulated rows and a linear model

outcome: A model in use can be challenged with newer labelled rows: the comparison is on rows neither model saw, with the project's measure and an interval, recorded in the ledger and proposed as a lesson, and the holdout is never read.
lessons: A comparison window is only fair if neither model saw its rows, its entities or its time.
Newer rows must be read exactly as the training rows were, or the champion meets data it never learned the shape of.
risks: an equally good challenger promoted now and then
newer rows whose columns changed meaning
